content: 另外检查现在的配置的git仓库是否全部覆盖设置路径

args.query: git repo config path settings nanobot

args.command: cd /root/nanobot-src && git ls-files | grep -iE 'config|setting|\.json|\.yaml|\.yml|\.toml|\.env' | head -50
ls -la ~/.nanobot/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && ls -la ~/.nanobot/agents/ 2>/dev/null
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files 2>/dev/null | head -80
cd ~/.nanobot && git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -50
cd ~/.nanobot && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files | grep -vE 'media/|sessions/|\.bak|workspace/' | sort

# Check what important config files exist on disk but are NOT in git
cd ~/.nanobot && comm -23 <(ls -1 *.json *.txt 2>/dev/null | sort) <(git ls-files -- '*.json' '*.txt' | xargs -I{} basename {} | sort -u)

# Check agents dirs - what's on disk vs in git
cd ~/.nanobot && for d in agents/*/; do
  name=$(basename "$d")
  disk_files=$(ls "$d" 2>/dev/null | sort)
  git_files=$(git ls-files "$d" | sed "s|^$d||" | sort)
  missing=$(comm -23 <(echo "$disk_files") <(echo "$git_files"))
  if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
    echo "=== $name MISSING from git ==="
    echo "$missing"
  fi
done

args.command:
# Check what config files exist on disk but are NOT tracked by git
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE 'workspace/|collab-sessions/|backups/|__pycache__|\.log$|\.env$|\.backup_pre_vcs|memory_palace\.bak|memory_rag/' | head -50

# Check nanobot_tools.json - is it tracked?
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files nanobot_tools.json && echo "---content---" && cat nanobot_tools.json

# Check .env - is it tracked? (it shouldn't be)
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files .env; echo "exit: $?"

args.command:
# Check what's in .git/info/exclude (additional ignore rules)
cd ~/.nanobot && cat .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null

# Check if prompt_order.json, prompt_overrides.json, prompt_visibility.json are tracked
cd ~/.nanobot && for f in prompt_order.json prompt_overrides.json prompt_visibility.json user_prefs.json providers_models.json hyperparams.json history_settings.json groupchat_settings.json groups.json custom_prompt_labels.json leader.txt chat_mode.txt; do
  tracked=$(git ls-files "$f" | head -1)
  if [ -n "$tracked" ]; then
    echo "✅ $f"
  else
    echo "❌ $f (NOT tracked)"
  fi
done

# Check if agents/jobs has config.json tracked
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files agents/jobs/

# agents/jobs has no config.json tracked - check if it exists on disk
cd ~/.nanobot && ls -la agents/jobs/ 2>/dev/null

# Check agents/reader - tracked vs disk
cd ~/.nanobot && echo "=== tracked ===" && git ls-files agents/reader/ && echo "=== on disk ===" && ls -la agents/reader/ 2>/dev/null

# Check the modified files - what changed since last commit
cd ~/.nanobot && git diff --stat HEAD

# Check if .env is in .gitignore properly
cd ~/.nanobot && grep -n '\.env' .gitignore

# Check what the code reads - config paths
cd /root/nanobot-src && cat nanobot/config/paths.py

args.command:
# Check what config files the code actually reads
cd /root/nanobot-src && grep -rn 'config\.json\|providers_models\|nanobot_tools\|prompt_order\|prompt_overrides\|prompt_visibility\|hyperparams\|history_settings\|groupchat_settings\|groups\.json\|custom_prompt_labels\|leader\.txt\|chat_mode\|user_prefs\|active_agents' nanobot/config/ nanobot/channels/ nanobot/groupchat/ --include='*.py' -l 2>/dev/null | sort -u

# Check if there are any config files read that are NOT in git
cd /root/nanobot-src && grep -rohn 'open.*\.json\|load.*\.json\|read.*\.json\|\.json.*load\|\.json.*read' nanobot/ --include='*.py' | grep -iE 'config|setting|prompt|tool|model|provider|agent|group|history|hyper|pref|leader|chat_mode|active' | head -30

# Check loader.py to see all config files it reads
cd /root/nanobot-src && cat nanobot/config/loader.py

# Check what JSON files the telegram channel reads
cd /root/nanobot-src && grep -rn '\.json' nanobot/channels/telegram/__init__.py | grep -v '__pycache__' | head -20

# Check all hardcoded config file paths in the codebase
cd /root/nanobot-src && grep -rn '\.nanobot.*\.json\|\.nanobot.*\.txt\|\.nanobot.*\.md' nanobot/ --include='*.py' | grep -v '__pycache__\|test_\|\.pyc\|sessions/' | sort -u

# Now check: which of these files exist on disk but are NOT in git
cd ~/.nanobot && for f in \
  config.json \
  nanobot_tools.json \
  providers_models.json \
  hyperparams.json \
  history_settings.json \
  groupchat_settings.json \
  prompt_order.json \
  prompt_visibility.json \
  custom_prompt_labels.json \
  active_agents.json \
  user_prefs.json \
  leader.txt \
  chat_mode.txt \
  groups.json \
  prompt_overrides.json \
  agents/beholder/config.json \
  agents/benjamin/config.json \
  agents/benjamin/character.json \
  agents/harper/config.json \
  agents/harper/character.json \
  agents/harper/INSTRUCTIONS.md \
  agents/kirk/config.json \
  agents/kirk/INSTRUCTIONS.md \
  agents/lucas/config.json \
  agents/lucas/character.json \
  agents/reader/config.json \
  agents/retriever/config.json \
  agents/scholar/config.json \
  agents/user/config.json \
  agents/verifier/config.json \
  cron/jobs.json \
  memory/MEMORY.md \
  memory/HISTORY.md; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    tracked=$(git ls-files "$f" | head -1)
    if [ -z "$tracked" ]; then
      echo "❌ NOT TRACKED: $f"
    fi
  else
    echo "⚠️  MISSING: $f"
  fi
done

# Check prompts/ directory - which prompt .md files are tracked
cd ~/.nanobot && for f in prompts/*.md; do
  name=$(basename "$f")
  tracked=$(git ls-files "prompts/$name" | head -1)
  if [ -z "$tracked" ]; then
    echo "❌ NOT TRACKED: prompts/$name"
  fi
done

args.command:
# Check Lucas config files
cd ~/.nanobot && ls -la agents/lucas/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && cat agents/lucas/config.json 2>/dev/null

# Check if Lucas files are tracked in git
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files agents/lucas/

# Check if Lucas .env is tracked
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files agents/lucas/.env

# Check ALL .env files across all agents
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files '**/.env'

# Check what sensitive files might be tracked - look for tokens/keys in tracked files
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files | xargs grep -l 'TELEGRAM_TOKEN\|OPENROUTER_APIKEY\|sk-or-v1\|AAE' 2>/dev/null | head -20

# Check .gitignore
cd ~/.nanobot && cat .gitignore

# Verify: are these secrets actually in git history?
cd ~/.nanobot && git log --oneline -5

# Check what's in providers_models.json - does it have keys?
cd ~/.nanobot && grep -c 'sk-or-v1\|AAE\|APIKEY\|api_key\|token' providers_models.json 2>/dev/null

# Check if request_logs is actually tracked despite .gitignore
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files request_logs/ | head -5

# Check if media/ is tracked
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files media/ | head -10

# Check if config.json.bak is tracked
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files '*.bak*'

# Check if mempalace/ is tracked despite .gitignore
cd ~/.nanobot && git ls-files mempalace/
